verdict.rationale: First-party docs show the MCP plugin lets an app act as an OAuth authorization server for Model Context Protocol clients. The Device Authorization plugin implements RFC 8628 code issuance and approval, and the JWT plugin exposes token and JWKS endpoints. A community commenter also says Better Auth can act as an identity provider and OIDC/SSO provider. However, the documented authorization-server role is scoped to MCP clients rather than general third-party 'Sign in with my app' clients. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a general-purpose OAuth/OIDC provider plugin, third-party client registration and consent flow, and hands-on corroboration of third-party sign-in.
